From Stdlib Require Export Strings.String FunctionalExtensionality.
From stdpp Require Export gmap fin.

Open Scope string_scope.

(* Expressions and values *)
(* ---------------------- *)

Inductive expr :=
  | Val : val -> expr
  | Var : string -> expr
  | Fun : string -> expr -> expr
  | App : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Unit : expr
  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetPair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Sum : nat -> expr -> expr
  | MatchSum n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr
  | Fork : expr -> expr
with val :=
  | FunV : string -> expr -> val
  | UnitV : val
  | PairV : val -> val -> val
  | SumV : nat -> val -> val
  | BarrierV : nat -> val.


(* Type system *)
(* ----------- *)

Inductive linearity := Lin | Unr.

CoInductive type :=
  | FunT : linearity -> type -> type -> type
  | UnitT : type
  | PairT : type -> type -> type
  | SumT n : (fin n -> type) -> type.

CoInductive unr : type -> Prop :=
  | Fun_unr t1 t2 : unr (FunT Unr t1 t2)
  | Unit_unr : unr UnitT
  | Pair_unr t1 t2 : unr t1 -> unr t2 -> unr (PairT t1 t2)
  | Sum_unr n ts : (∀ i, unr (ts i)) -> unr (SumT n ts).

(* We define linear environment splitting here.
   On paper this is implicit in Γ1,Γ2 ⊢ e : A.
   In Coq we have to explicitly say env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2, and typed Γ e A. *)
Definition env := gmap string type.

Definition env_unr (Γ : env) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unr t.

Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : env) :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 = t2 ∧ unr t1.

Definition env_split (Γ : env) (Γ1 : env) (Γ2 : env) :=
  Γ = Γ1 ∪ Γ2 ∧ disj Γ1 Γ2.

Definition env_bind (Γ' : env) (x : string) (t : type) (Γ : env) :=
  Γ' = <[ x := t ]> Γ ∧ ∀ t', Γ !! x = Some t' -> unr t'.

Definition env_var (Γ : env) (x : string) (t : type) :=
  ∃ Γ', Γ = <[ x := t ]> Γ' ∧ env_unr Γ'.


Inductive typed : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | Var_typed Γ x t :
    env_var Γ x t ->
    typed Γ (Var x) t
  | Fun_typed Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
    env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
    (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
    typed Γ' e t2 ->
    typed Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | App_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | Unit_typed Γ :
    env_unr Γ ->
    typed Γ Unit UnitT
  | Pair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t2 ->
    typed Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
    typed Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | Sum_typed Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
    typed Γ e (ts i) ->
    typed Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumN_typed n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
    typed Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
    (∀ i, typed Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
    typed Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | Fork_typed Γ e t1 t2 :
    typed Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
    typed Γ (Fork e) (FunT Lin t1 t2).

Require Import Language.

(* Session types *)

CoInductive session_type :=
  | SendTB n : (fin n -> type) -> (fin n -> session_type) -> session_type
  | RecvTB n : (fin n -> type) -> (fin n -> session_type) -> session_type
  | EndTB : session_type.


(* The original artifact obtains this equality instance from its Leibniz OFE. *)
Global Instance payload_type_equiv : Equiv type := eq.

Global Instance finvec_equiv `{Equiv T} n : Equiv (fin n -> T) := λ f g, ∀ i, f i ≡ g i.

CoInductive session_type_equiv : Equiv session_type :=
  | cteq_EndT : EndTB ≡ EndTB
  | cteq_SendT n t1 t2 f1 f2 : t1 ≡ t2 -> f1 ≡ f2 -> SendTB n t1 f1 ≡ SendTB n t2 f2
  | cteq_RecvT n t1 t2 f1 f2 : t1 ≡ t2 -> f1 ≡ f2 -> RecvTB n t1 f1 ≡ RecvTB n t2 f2.
Global Existing Instance session_type_equiv.

Parameter session_type_extensionality : ∀ σ1 σ2 : session_type, σ1 ≡ σ2 -> σ1 = σ2.

(*
  Coq's default notion of equality is not good enough for coinductive types:
   the default equality is syntactic equality and not extensional equality.
   We add an axiom to make equality extensional.
   See https://coq.inria.fr/refman/language/core/coinductive.html:
   "More generally, as in the case of positive coinductive types,
   it is consistent to further identify extensional equality of coinductive
   types with propositional equality"
   Such an axiom is similar to functional extensionality, but for coinductive types.
*)

CoFixpoint dual (σ : session_type) : session_type :=
  match σ with
  | SendTB n ts σs => RecvTB n ts (dual ∘ σs)
  | RecvTB n ts σs => SendTB n ts (dual ∘ σs)
  | EndTB => EndTB
  end.

(* Interpretation of session types into linear lambda calculus types *)

CoFixpoint toL (σ : session_type) : type :=
  match σ with
  | SendTB n ts σs => FunT Lin (SumT n (λ i, PairT (toL (dual $ σs i)) (ts i))) UnitT
  | RecvTB n ts σs => FunT Lin UnitT (SumT n (λ i, PairT (toL (σs i)) (ts i)))
  | EndTB => FunT Lin UnitT UnitT
  end.

(* Session type operations in terms of binary barriers *)

Definition SendB e1 i e2 :=
    LetPair (Pair e1 e2) (Fun "x" (Fun "y"
      (Fork (Fun "z" (App (Var "x") (Sum i (Pair (Var "z") (Var "y")))))))).
Definition RecvB e := App e Unit.
Definition ForkB e := Fork e.
Definition CloseB (e : expr) := App e Unit.

(* monomorphic env lemmas *)
Lemma env_lookup_empty (i : string) : (∅ : env) !! i = None.

Lemma env_lookup_insert (i j : string) (x : type) (m : env) :

Lemma env_lookup_insert_ne (i j : string) (x : type) (m : env) :

Proof. apply lookup_insert_ne. Qed.
Lemma env_lookup_union (i : string) (m1 m2 : env) :

Proof. apply lookup_union. Qed.
Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof. apply map_union_empty. Qed.
Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof. apply map_empty_union. Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr ∅.

Lemma env_split_empty_r (Γ : env) : env_split Γ Γ ∅.
Proof.

Qed.

(* type unfolding *)
Lemma type_eta (t : type) :
  t = match t with
      | FunT l a b => FunT l a b
      | UnitT => UnitT
      | PairT a b => PairT a b
      | SumT n ts => SumT n ts
      end.
Proof. destruct t; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma st_eta (σ : session_type) :
  σ = match σ with
      | SendTB n ts σs => SendTB n ts σs
      | RecvTB n ts σs => RecvTB n ts σs
      | EndTB => EndTB
      end.
Proof. destruct σ; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_Send n ts σs :
  toL (SendTB n ts σs) = FunT Lin (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (dual (σs i))) (ts i))) UnitT.
Proof. rewrite (type_eta (toL (SendTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma toL_Recv n ts σs :
  toL (RecvTB n ts σs) = FunT Lin UnitT (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (σs i)) (ts i))).
Proof. rewrite (type_eta (toL (RecvTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma toL_End : toL EndTB = FunT Lin UnitT UnitT.
Proof. rewrite (type_eta (toL EndTB)). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_Send n ts σs : dual (SendTB n ts σs) = RecvTB n ts (dual ∘ σs).
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (SendTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma dual_Recv n ts σs : dual (RecvTB n ts σs) = SendTB n ts (dual ∘ σs).
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (RecvTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma dual_End : dual EndTB = EndTB.
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual EndTB)). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_dual_End :

Proof.

  - exact H.
  - apply Unit_typed. apply env_unr_empty.
Qed.

(* ForkB *)
Theorem ForkB_typed Γ σ e :

  - rewrite toL_End.

Qed.

Require Import Language Sessions.
From stdpp Require Import tactics.

(* ---------- montone env lemmas ---------- *)
Lemma env_lookup_empty (i : string) : (∅ : env) !! i = None.
Proof. apply lookup_empty. Qed.
Lemma env_lookup_insert (i j : string) (x : type) (m : env) :
  (<[i:=x]> m) !! j = (if decide (i = j) then Some x else m !! j).
Proof. apply lookup_insert. Qed.
Lemma env_lookup_insert_ne (i j : string) (x : type) (m : env) :
  i ≠ j -> (<[i:=x]> m) !! j = m !! j.
Proof. apply lookup_insert_ne. Qed.
Lemma env_lookup_union (i : string) (m1 m2 : env) :
  (m1 ∪ m2) !! i = (m1 !! i) ∪ (m2 !! i).
Proof. apply lookup_union. Qed.
Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof. apply map_union_empty. Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr ∅.
Proof. intros x t H. rewrite env_lookup_empty in H. discriminate H. Qed.
Lemma env_split_empty_r (Γ : env) : env_split Γ Γ ∅.
Proof.
  split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_r.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. rewrite env_lookup_empty in H2. discriminate H2.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_lookup_none (m : env) (y : string) :
  m !! y = None -> ∀ t', m !! y = Some t' -> unr t'.
Proof. intros Hm t' H. rewrite Hm in H. discriminate H. Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_ne (m : env) (x y : string) (t : type) :
  x ≠ y ->
  (∀ t', m !! y = Some t' -> unr t') ->
  ∀ t', (<[x := t]> m) !! y = Some t' -> unr t'.
Proof.
  intros Hne Hm t' H.
  rewrite env_lookup_insert in H.
  destruct (decide (x = y)) as [E|E]; [congruence |].
  apply Hm. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_self (x : string) (t : type) : env_var (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) x t.
Proof. exists ∅. split; [reflexivity | apply env_unr_empty]. Qed.

Lemma disj_of_disjoint (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : Γ1 ##ₘ Γ2 -> disj Γ1 Γ2.
Proof.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  apply (map_disjoint_spec Γ1 Γ2) in H.
  exact (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

(* ---------- type / session unfolding ---------- *)
Lemma type_eta (t : type) :
  t = match t with
      | FunT l a b => FunT l a b
      | UnitT => UnitT
      | PairT a b => PairT a b
      | SumT n ts => SumT n ts
      end.
Proof. destruct t; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma st_eta (σ : session_type) :
  σ = match σ with
      | SendTB n ts σs => SendTB n ts σs
      | RecvTB n ts σs => RecvTB n ts σs
      | EndTB => EndTB
      end.
Proof. destruct σ; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_Send n ts σs :
  toL (SendTB n ts σs) = FunT Lin (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (dual (σs i))) (ts i))) UnitT.
Proof. rewrite (type_eta (toL (SendTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma toL_Recv n ts σs :
  toL (RecvTB n ts σs) = FunT Lin UnitT (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (σs i)) (ts i))).
Proof. rewrite (type_eta (toL (RecvTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma toL_End : toL EndTB = FunT Lin UnitT UnitT.
Proof. rewrite (type_eta (toL EndTB)). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_Send n ts σs : dual (SendTB n ts σs) = RecvTB n ts (dual ∘ σs).
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (SendTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma dual_Recv n ts σs : dual (RecvTB n ts σs) = SendTB n ts (dual ∘ σs).
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (RecvTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma dual_End : dual EndTB = EndTB.
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual EndTB)). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_dual_Send n ts σs :
  toL (dual (SendTB n ts σs)) = FunT Lin UnitT (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (dual (σs i))) (ts i))).
Proof. rewrite dual_Send. rewrite toL_Recv. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma toL_dual_Recv n ts σs :
  toL (dual (RecvTB n ts σs)) = FunT Lin (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (dual (dual (σs i)))) (ts i))) UnitT.
Proof. rewrite dual_Recv. rewrite (toL_Send n ts (dual ∘ σs)). reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma toL_dual_End : toL (dual EndTB) = FunT Lin UnitT UnitT.
Proof. rewrite dual_End. apply toL_End. Qed.

Lemma dual_dual_Send n ts σs :
  dual (dual (SendTB n ts σs)) = SendTB n ts (dual ∘ (dual ∘ σs)).
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (dual (SendTB n ts σs)))). reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma dual_dual_Recv n ts σs :
  dual (dual (RecvTB n ts σs)) = RecvTB n ts (dual ∘ (dual ∘ σs)).
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (dual (RecvTB n ts σs)))). reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma dual_dual_End : dual (dual EndTB) = EndTB.
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (dual EndTB))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_dual_equiv : forall σ : session_type, dual (dual σ) ≡ σ.
Proof.
  cofix IH. intros σ. destruct σ as [n ts σs | n ts σs | ].
  - rewrite (dual_dual_Send n ts σs).
    apply (cteq_SendT n ts ts (dual ∘ (dual ∘ σs)) σs (fun i => eq_refl) (fun i => IH (σs i))).
  - rewrite (dual_dual_Recv n ts σs).
    apply (cteq_RecvT n ts ts (dual ∘ (dual ∘ σs)) σs (fun i => eq_refl) (fun i => IH (σs i))).
  - rewrite dual_dual_End. apply cteq_EndT.
Qed.

  session_type_extensionality _ _ (dual_dual_equiv σ).

Theorem ForkB_typed Γ σ e :
  typed Γ e (FunT Lin (toL (dual σ)) UnitT) ->

Proof.

  - rewrite toL_End.

Qed.

Require Import Language Sessions.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Environment lemmas                                                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Coq's reduction only unfolds a cofixpoint when it is scrutinised by a
   match.  Consequently, facts about the interpretations of session types
   are established below through eta-expansions (see [type_eta] and
   [st_eta]) that expose the cofixpoints to a match. *)

Lemma env_lookup_empty (i : string) : (∅ : env) !! i = None.
Proof. apply lookup_empty. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert (i j : string) (x : type) (m : env) :
  (<[i:=x]> m) !! j = (if decide (i = j) then Some x else m !! j).
Proof. apply lookup_insert. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof. apply map_union_empty. Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr ∅.
Proof. intros x t H. rewrite env_lookup_empty in H. discriminate H. Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty_r (Γ : env) : env_split Γ Γ ∅.
Proof.
  split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_r.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. rewrite env_lookup_empty in H2. discriminate H2.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_lookup_none (m : env) (y : string) :
  m !! y = None -> ∀ t', m !! y = Some t' -> unr t'.
Proof. intros Hm t' H. rewrite Hm in H. discriminate H. Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_ne (m : env) (x y : string) (t : type) :
  x ≠ y ->
  (∀ t', m !! y = Some t' -> unr t') ->
  ∀ t', (<[x := t]> m) !! y = Some t' -> unr t'.
Proof.
  intros Hne Hm t' H.
  rewrite env_lookup_insert in H.
  destruct (decide (x = y)) as [E|E]; [congruence |].
  apply Hm. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_self (x : string) (t : type) : env_var (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) x t.
Proof. exists ∅. split; [reflexivity | apply env_unr_empty]. Qed.

Lemma disj_of_disjoint (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : Γ1 ##ₘ Γ2 -> disj Γ1 Γ2.
Proof.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  exfalso. exact (proj1 (map_disjoint_spec Γ1 Γ2) H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Unfolding of the session type interpretations                       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma type_eta (t : type) :
  t = match t with
      | FunT l a b => FunT l a b
      | UnitT => UnitT
      | PairT a b => PairT a b
      | SumT n ts => SumT n ts
      end.
Proof. destruct t; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma st_eta (σ : session_type) :
  σ = match σ with
      | SendTB n ts σs => SendTB n ts σs
      | RecvTB n ts σs => RecvTB n ts σs
      | EndTB => EndTB
      end.
Proof. destruct σ; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_Send n ts σs :
  toL (SendTB n ts σs) =
  FunT Lin (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (dual (σs i))) (ts i))) UnitT.
Proof. rewrite (type_eta (toL (SendTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_Recv n ts σs :
  toL (RecvTB n ts σs) =
  FunT Lin UnitT (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (σs i)) (ts i))).
Proof. rewrite (type_eta (toL (RecvTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_End : toL EndTB = FunT Lin UnitT UnitT.
Proof. rewrite (type_eta (toL EndTB)). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_Send n ts σs : dual (SendTB n ts σs) = RecvTB n ts (dual ∘ σs).
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (SendTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_Recv n ts σs : dual (RecvTB n ts σs) = SendTB n ts (dual ∘ σs).
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (RecvTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_End : dual EndTB = EndTB.
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual EndTB)). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_dual_Send n ts σs :
  toL (dual (SendTB n ts σs)) =
  FunT Lin UnitT (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (dual (σs i))) (ts i))).
Proof. rewrite dual_Send. rewrite toL_Recv. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_dual_Recv n ts σs :
  toL (dual (RecvTB n ts σs)) =
  FunT Lin (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (dual (dual (σs i)))) (ts i))) UnitT.
Proof. rewrite dual_Recv. rewrite (toL_Send n ts (dual ∘ σs)). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_dual_End : toL (dual EndTB) = FunT Lin UnitT UnitT.
Proof. rewrite dual_End. apply toL_End. Qed.

Lemma dual_dual_Send n ts σs :
  dual (dual (SendTB n ts σs)) = SendTB n ts (dual ∘ (dual ∘ σs)).
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (dual (SendTB n ts σs)))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_dual_Recv n ts σs :
  dual (dual (RecvTB n ts σs)) = RecvTB n ts (dual ∘ (dual ∘ σs)).
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (dual (RecvTB n ts σs)))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_dual_End : dual (dual EndTB) = EndTB.
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (dual EndTB))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_dual_equiv : ∀ σ : session_type, dual (dual σ) ≡ σ.
Proof.
  cofix IH. intros σ. destruct σ as [n ts σs | n ts σs | ].
  - rewrite (dual_dual_Send n ts σs).
    apply (cteq_SendT n ts ts (dual ∘ (dual ∘ σs)) σs
             (fun i => eq_refl) (fun i => IH (σs i))).
  - rewrite (dual_dual_Recv n ts σs).
    apply (cteq_RecvT n ts ts (dual ∘ (dual ∘ σs)) σs
             (fun i => eq_refl) (fun i => IH (σs i))).
  - rewrite dual_dual_End. apply cteq_EndT.
Qed.

Lemma dual_dual (σ : session_type) : dual (dual σ) = σ.
Proof. apply session_type_extensionality, dual_dual_equiv. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Derived typing rules                                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem ForkB_typed Γ σ e :
  typed Γ e (FunT Lin (toL (dual σ)) UnitT) ->
  typed Γ (ForkB e) (toL σ).
Proof.
  intros H. unfold ForkB.
  destruct σ as [n ts σs | n ts σs | ].
  - rewrite toL_Send.
    eapply Fork_typed with
        (t1 := SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (dual (σs i))) (ts i))) (t2 := UnitT).
    rewrite toL_dual_Send in H. exact H.
  - rewrite toL_Recv.
    eapply Fork_typed with
        (t1 := UnitT) (t2 := SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (σs i)) (ts i))).
    rewrite toL_dual_Recv in H.
    replace (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (dual (dual (σs i)))) (ts i)))
      with (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (σs i)) (ts i))) in H.
    + exact H.
    + apply f_equal. apply functional_extensionality. intro i.
      rewrite (dual_dual (σs i)). reflexivity.
  - rewrite toL_End.
    eapply Fork_typed with (t1 := UnitT) (t2 := UnitT).
    rewrite toL_dual_End in H. exact H.
Qed.

Theorem SendB_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 n ts σs i :

Require Import Language Sessions.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Environment lemmas                                                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Coq's reduction only unfolds a cofixpoint when it is scrutinised by a
   match.  Consequently, facts about the interpretations of session types
   are established below through eta-expansions (see [type_eta] and
   [st_eta]) that expose the cofixpoints to a match. *)

Lemma env_lookup_empty (i : string) : (∅ : env) !! i = None.
Proof. apply lookup_empty. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert (i j : string) (x : type) (m : env) :
  (<[i:=x]> m) !! j = (if decide (i = j) then Some x else m !! j).
Proof. apply lookup_insert. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof. apply map_union_empty. Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr ∅.
Proof. intros x t H. rewrite env_lookup_empty in H. discriminate H. Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty_r (Γ : env) : env_split Γ Γ ∅.
Proof.
  split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_r.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. rewrite env_lookup_empty in H2. discriminate H2.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_lookup_none (m : env) (y : string) :
  m !! y = None -> ∀ t', m !! y = Some t' -> unr t'.
Proof. intros Hm t' H. rewrite Hm in H. discriminate H. Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_ne (m : env) (x y : string) (t : type) :
  x ≠ y ->
  (∀ t', m !! y = Some t' -> unr t') ->
  ∀ t', (<[x := t]> m) !! y = Some t' -> unr t'.
Proof.
  intros Hne Hm t' H.
  rewrite env_lookup_insert in H.
  destruct (decide (x = y)) as [E|E]; [congruence |].
  apply Hm. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_self (x : string) (t : type) : env_var (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) x t.
Proof. exists ∅. split; [reflexivity | apply env_unr_empty]. Qed.

Lemma disj_of_disjoint (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : Γ1 ##ₘ Γ2 -> disj Γ1 Γ2.
Proof.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  exfalso. exact (proj1 (map_disjoint_spec Γ1 Γ2) H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Unfolding of the session type interpretations                       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma type_eta (t : type) :
  t = match t with
      | FunT l a b => FunT l a b
      | UnitT => UnitT
      | PairT a b => PairT a b
      | SumT n ts => SumT n ts
      end.
Proof. destruct t; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma st_eta (σ : session_type) :
  σ = match σ with
      | SendTB n ts σs => SendTB n ts σs
      | RecvTB n ts σs => RecvTB n ts σs
      | EndTB => EndTB
      end.
Proof. destruct σ; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_Send n ts σs :
  toL (SendTB n ts σs) =
  FunT Lin (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (dual (σs i))) (ts i))) UnitT.
Proof. rewrite (type_eta (toL (SendTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_Recv n ts σs :
  toL (RecvTB n ts σs) =
  FunT Lin UnitT (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (σs i)) (ts i))).
Proof. rewrite (type_eta (toL (RecvTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_End : toL EndTB = FunT Lin UnitT UnitT.
Proof. rewrite (type_eta (toL EndTB)). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_Send n ts σs : dual (SendTB n ts σs) = RecvTB n ts (dual ∘ σs).
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (SendTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_Recv n ts σs : dual (RecvTB n ts σs) = SendTB n ts (dual ∘ σs).
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (RecvTB n ts σs))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_End : dual EndTB = EndTB.
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual EndTB)). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_dual_Send n ts σs :
  toL (dual (SendTB n ts σs)) =
  FunT Lin UnitT (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (dual (σs i))) (ts i))).
Proof. rewrite dual_Send. rewrite toL_Recv. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_dual_Recv n ts σs :
  toL (dual (RecvTB n ts σs)) =
  FunT Lin (SumT n (fun i => PairT (toL (dual (dual (σs i)))) (ts i))) UnitT.
Proof. rewrite dual_Recv. rewrite (toL_Send n ts (dual ∘ σs)). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma toL_dual_End : toL (dual EndTB) = FunT Lin UnitT UnitT.
Proof. rewrite dual_End. apply toL_End. Qed.

Lemma dual_dual_Send n ts σs :
  dual (dual (SendTB n ts σs)) = SendTB n ts (dual ∘ (dual ∘ σs)).
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (dual (SendTB n ts σs)))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_dual_Recv n ts σs :
  dual (dual (RecvTB n ts σs)) = RecvTB n ts (dual ∘ (dual ∘ σs)).
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (dual (RecvTB n ts σs)))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_dual_End : dual (dual EndTB) = EndTB.
Proof. rewrite (st_eta (dual (dual EndTB))). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dual_dual_equiv : ∀ σ : session_type, dual (dual σ) ≡ σ.
Proof.
  cofix IH. intros σ. destruct σ as [n ts σs | n ts σs | ].
  - rewrite (dual_dual_Send n ts σs).
    apply (cteq_SendT n ts ts (dual ∘ (dual ∘ σs)) σs
             (fun i => eq_refl) (fun i => IH (σs i))).
  - rewrite (dual_dual_Recv n ts σs).
    apply (cteq_RecvT n ts ts (dual ∘ (dual ∘ σs)) σs
             (fun i => eq_refl) (fun i => IH (σs i))).
  - rewrite dual_dual_End. apply cteq_EndT.
Qed.

Lemma dual_dual (σ : session_type) : dual (dual σ) = σ.
Proof. apply session_type_extensionality, dual_dual_equiv. Qed.

All four targets are proved and `make` succeeds from a clean build.

## Summary

The main obstacle was a Rocq semantics detail: **cofixpoints are only unfolded when scrutinised by a `match`** — `toL (SendTB …)` (and `dual (dual σ)`) are not convertible to their unfolding at head position, so the naive `destruct`/`cbn`/`reflexivity` approach dead-ends (even `reflexivity` on a cofix applied to a constructor fails).

The solution uses an **eta-expansion trick**: since `type` and `session_type` are coinductive, `destruct t; reflexivity` proves

```
t = match t with FunT l a b => FunT l a b | … end
```

and the resulting match *does* reduce, because the cofixpoint is now the match scrutinee. That yields the unfolding lemmas `toL_Send`, `toL_Recv`, `toL_End`, `dual_Send/Recv/End`, and the nested `dual (dual …)` unfoldings.

From there:
- **`CloseB_typed` / `RecvB_typed`** — `App_typed` with the body environment split as `Γ = Γ ∪ ∅`.
- **`ForkB_typed`** — case on `σ`; `Fork_typed` plus `toL (dual σ)` unfolding; the `RecvTB` case needs `dual (dual σ) = σ`, proved by a `cofix` of the coinductive `≡` (using the supplied `session_type_extensionality`) and rewriting `toL (dual (dual …))` under the `SumT` binder via `functional_extensionality`.
- **`SendB_typed`** — `LetPair_typed` splits off the empty environment, `Pair_typed` uses the supplied split, then two nested `Fun_typed` rules and the now-proved `ForkB_typed`; the inner `App`/`Pair`/`Sum` derivation uses three concrete environment splits proved by `set_solver` plus a `disj`-from-`##ₘ` lemma.

`make` compiles `Language.v`, `Sessions.v`, and `Task.v` cleanly. `Print Assumptions` shows the two `App`-based rules are fully closed, and the two `Fork`-based rules rely only on the pre-supplied `session_type_extensionality` and Stdlib's `functional_extensionality_dep` (already imported by `Language.v`) — no new axioms, `Admitted`, or `Abort`, and the four theorem statements are byte-identical to the originals.
